SUMMARY.md: Playlist title, for example 'Trending videos on WWE.com'.
Superstar display name in upper case, for example '"MR. PERFECT" CURT HENNIG'.

Unofficial: the JSON endpoints behind `www.wwe.com`, as wrapped by the Swift client https://github.com/l0v3m0n3y/wwe (src/wwe.swift). Not a documented or supported public API; WWE can change it at any time. Endpoints and parameter order were taken from that client; every schema was taken from live GET probes on 2026-10-23 (no key needed). Only endpoints on https://www.wwe.com are modelled because a spec has one server: the client's search (https://search.wwe.com/api/v1/search, which also worked keyless) and VOD entitlement (https://vod.wwe.com/v1/entitlement/{id}, not probed) calls are omitted. Field types are as observed and are inconsistent between endpoints (nid is a string in highlight-videos and gallery-related but an integer in the playlists). Unverified: the effect of non-zero playlistId/offset values, and the item shape of the always-empty sponsors arrays. Videos in the probes were geo-tagged with `country_logic` and the highlight titles came back in Arabic, so content may vary by requester location.
